name: dropdown-03
title: Menu with icons
description: Each action leads with a muted icon.

files.content:
import {
  BoltIcon,
  ChevronDownIcon,
  CopyPlusIcon,
  FilesIcon,
  Layers2Icon,
} from '@/registry/ndeko/lib/icons';
import { Button } from '@/registry/ndeko/ui/button';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from '@/registry/ndeko/ui/dropdown-menu';

export default function Dropdown03() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant='outline' />}>
        Layer options
        <ChevronDownIcon className='-me-1 opacity-60' />
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <CopyPlusIcon />
          Copy
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <BoltIcon />
          Edit
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Layers2Icon />
          Group
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <FilesIcon />
          Clone
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
